                THE GAUHATI HIGH COURT
(HIGH COURT OF ASSAM, NAGALAND, MIZORAM AND ARUNACHAL PRADESH)
Case No. : WP(C)/XXXX/2024
PETITIONER D
D/O PARENT D, R/O MASKED, DIST. MASKED, ASSAM
VERSUS
THE STATE OF ASSAM AND 2 ORS
REP. BY THE COMMISSIONER AND SECRETARY TO THE GOVT. OF ASSAM,
SECONDARY EDUCATION DEPARTMENT, DISPUR, GUWAHATI-6
Advocate for the Petitioner     : MR. ADVOCATE G
Advocate for the Respondent : SC, SEC. EDU.

BEFORE
HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE JUDGE C
ORDER
Date :  10.03.2025
1.     Heard Mr. Advocate G, learned counsel for the petitioner. Also heard Mr.
Advocate H, learned Standing Counsel, Secondary Education Department.
2.     The petitioner's case is that she was appointed as an Assistant Teacher
and her salary for the period from April, 2023 has not been released. The
petitioner submitted a representation dated 12.08.2024 before the respondent

<FF>Page No.# 2/3
authorities, which remains undisposed of.
3.     The writ petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India
seeking a direction for the release of the salary in terms of Rule 3 of the Assam
Secondary Education (Provincialised) Service Rules, 2004.
4.     Having considered the submissions, the respondent No. 2 is directed to
consider and dispose of the representation of the petitioner by passing a
reasoned order within a period of 30 (thirty) days from the date of this order.
5.     The respondents shall file an affidavit in the meantime, if so advised.
6.     With the above direction, the writ petition stands disposed of.


<FF>Page No.# 3/3

JUDGE
Comparing Assistant
